name: Stormwind Library
summary: In Stormwind Keep, Donyal Tovald copies the kingdom’s histories for those with library scrips. Young King Anduin Wrynn has set aside royal funds for the work, opening these accounts of Azeroth to citizens and scholars.

sections.title: A Royal Mandate for Knowledge
sections.body: While Highlord Bolvar Fordragon and Lady Katrana Prestor guide Stormwind’s defenses and court in King Varian’s absence, young King Anduin turns royal support toward learning. He funds copies of ancient manuscripts and historical journals, so the kingdom’s past can be preserved and studied. Within Stormwind Keep, the Royal Library keeps these written accounts and copies them for those in royal service.

sections.title: The Scrip Exchange
sections.body: Hand copying delicate parchment takes time, ink, and royal sanction. Librarian Donyal Tovald accepts official library scrips issued to adventurers and scholars across Alliance territories. In return, he provides copies of historical works, from the ancient histories of the Eastern Kingdoms to accounts of distant lands, offering knowledge of conflicts beyond the capital.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Stormwind Library quest?
faq.answer: You can exchange a Library Scrip with librarian Donyal Tovald for a readable book. These books share histories of Alliance people, places, and events across Azeroth.
Donyal Tovald oversees the Royal Library in Stormwind Keep. He manages the kingdom’s written histories and distributes copies under King Anduin’s order.

faq.q: Where do you obtain a Library Scrip?
aliases: where do i get library scrip
faq.answer: Library Scrips are given across Alliance territories by scholars, magistrates, and officials who value learning about the wider world.

faq.q: Why is young King Anduin funding the library?
aliases: why does anduin care about books
faq.answer: King Anduin Wrynn funds copies of historical works because he values learning and education. While still a child, he set aside royal funds to make the kingdom’s histories available to the public under Regent Bolvar Fordragon’s guidance.

faq.q: Where is the library located in Stormwind?
faq.answer: The Royal Library is inside Stormwind Keep, the great fortress in the eastern part of the city. Donyal Tovald can be found among its shelves and reading tables.

faq.q: Can I read the books I receive?
faq.answer: Yes. Each book from the library can be read and offers background on legends and historical events across Azeroth.

angles.text: As a mage, you can turn to the Royal Library for the kingdom’s histories, alongside your arcane studies in the Mage Quarter.
As an Alliance citizen, you can find records of the triumphs and tragedies of the Alliance of Lordaeron, and the bonds between humans, dwarves, gnomes, and high elves.

As a human, you know the value of preserving history. Old Stormwind lost countless archives when it was sacked during the First War, and scholars now protect and copy the histories that survived the kingdom’s rebuilding.
